tools.name: split_into_layers
tools.description: Split a flat image (PNG, JPG or WebP, at least 512 × 512 px) into named transparent layers, with the hidden parts behind objects filled in. Costs 1 credit per layer returned (up to 17 by default, or up to 100 when prompt lists or asks for more parts); the account needs at least 5 credits to start. P

tools.name: get_layers
tools.description: Status of a split. When ready, returns every layer with its name, position and a PNG download URL valid for one hour. Free.

tools.name: unlock_layers
tools.description: For a split with status needs_credits: pay the extra credits owed (shown as credits.owed) so the layer files become available. Charges once even if called again.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Credits available on this Unmerge account. One credit is one layer returned.
